Annexure 02
Register of the officers who served for more than 06 years in Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education / National Schools/Institutions under the Central Government - 2027
Please make sure that the details of all the officers who have completed the period of service stated under No. 04 (4.1.1, 4.1.2, 4.1.3) of the circular are included herein (As at 31.12.2026)
Register of the officers who have served for more than 12 years in the institutions under a Provincial Council - 2027
Include names in descending order by longest service.

gold.issuedBy: Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education
gold.targetAudience: Heads of Department, Provincial Councils, Zonal Offices, institutions under central and provincial education administration
gold.title: MOE Circular 23/2026: Service registers for SLEAS and related officers (2027 exercise)

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.content: Requires institutions to complete annexure registers of Sri Lanka Education Administrative Service and related officers by length of service for the 2027 staffing exercise.

sections.heading: Key requirements
sections.content: Fill separate forms per SLEAS grade. List officers who completed the service periods in circular section 04 (including 6+ years in central institutions and 12+ years under Provincial Councils), ordered by longest service, with data as at 31.12.2026.

sections.heading: Deadlines & dates
sections.content: Service cut-off date for the registers: 31.12.2026.

sections.heading: Responsible parties
sections.content: Heads of Department, Provincial Councils, and Zonal/District offices must compile and submit Annexures 02/03 as applicable.

actionItems: Complete Annexure 02/03 registers for each SLEAS grade with data as at 31.12.2026.
Include all officers meeting the service-period criteria in circular section 04.
Sort names by longest continuous service first.
Submit compiled registers through the Provincial Council or Zonal Office channel.
